column6: LivingAttack: traders (deci.ai.a) and players in protected state cannot be attacked
LivingHurt: cancels damage to entities riding a vehicle seat
EntityInteract: right clicking a dropped item puts it in the inventory
EntityJoinWorld: syncs player data to clients on join, mob spawn handling
LivingDeath: humanity and clan score (dedicated only), corpses, keepInventory
ItemToss: forbids dropping gold bottlecaps in some places
LivingHurt: fire, ricochet sounds, leg breaks, damage overrides
CommandEvent: /clear also clears backpack, vest and mask
PlayerEvent.Clone: copies PlayerData to the respawned player
PlayerLoggedIn: resets per login state and sends the login packet
PlayerRespawn: picks a spawn from decimation_spawnpoints.properties
PlayerTick: ticks PlayerData, natural regeneration gamerule per player, vehicle riding
StartTracking: sends a tracked player's data to the watcher
WorldTick: wraps world time back to 0 after 24000
